discussion_comments.comment_body:
@rosanch Looks like majority of the commands actually use 'registry_name', options_list=['--registry', '-r'] instead of ['--name', '-n']. This '--name' was being used prior to my changes, and is also being used on line 82:
![image](https://github.com/Azure/azure-cli/assets/82487617/64383d28-afb7-41d0-88cf-4a6df47c7aa1)

I can update the check-health command to use ''--registry, -r " if that is the most current version.

Also, the already existing variable, 'image_by_tag_or_digest_type', uses [--image, 't'] but it is defined as "The name of the image. May include a tag in the format 'name:tag' or digest in the format 'name@digest'." It combines the repository name with tag or digest.

The reason I defined --image differently is because with this PR, the check-health command asks user for the repository name, then the image or tag separately and '--image, -t' in this case means either the digest itself ("sha256:123") or the tag ("latest").  I asked for repo name separately as it is used in the APIs for 'get blob' and 'get manifest'.

Alternatively, I could use '--digest' and '--tag' to make it more precise, or refactor code to use '--image' as previously defined and parse out the repo name in the code.
There were concerns that users would not always quickly recall the image digest and that '--image' might be a better blanket term. Open to suggestions and adding @estebanreyl and @AntonioVT  to this comment as they had some input into this.
